lines.text: God says the loyalty of Ephraim and Judah is like morning mist, and He has hewn them by the prophets.
God desires mercy, not sacrifice, and says that like Adam, His people have transgressed the covenant.
Gilead is a city of evildoers, and a band of priests murder on the way to Bethel.
When God heals Israel, the crimes of Jerusalem are exposed, and the people delight the king with their evil.
Their anger smolders all night and blazes in the morning, and they devour their rulers.
